Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:
 Disconnect Switch, 132kv
 II 200T,VRV-12
USSR ,Yugoslavia
Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection Y1, which must be performed every three times per year bases 
as indicated by M4 in the 
title block

The technical specification of the isolator (USSR) rated current = 600:1200A Rated 
voltage = 132 kv

The technical specification of the isolator (Yugoslavia) 
Rated current = 2000A 
Rated voltage = 132 kv
Max. voltage = 145 kv

The 
first draft is initiated and reviewed by eng. Soleiman Abd Elfattah Saleh, accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required
Wear safety equipment as helmet, shoes etc
Switch off the isolator
Switch off the, AC supply, DC supply
Switch on the earthing at disconnector sides
Safety helmet and safety shoes

Tools and Equipment
Portable air blower, metal brush
Human safety fence
Grease for lubricating (USSR grease 220)
Set of common, screw drivers, cleaning material and water pump
Work to be Carried Out
Check the mechanism of operation and lubricate the gears
Clean the insulation's of disconnector
Lubricate the axis
Check the tightening of (contacts, input bus bar, output bus 
 bar) bolts and nuts.
Check the presence of overheat and flashover of contacts
Examine the ear thing assembly mounted on disconnector
Testing the switch (on & off) manually operation of the 
 disconnector
Check hot spots of (contacts, input bus bar, output bus bar) 
 bolts and nuts
